detail.longDescription: 🧊 NEWS: The 2026 # Nobel prize in # physics went to physicist Francis Halzen for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the detection of high-energy # neutrinos from # space . Built into a cubic kilometer of Antarctic # ice at the # SouthPole , IceCube uses 5,160 optical sensors to catch faint flashes when neutrinos collide with atomic nuclei, letting researchers trace # particles back to distant cosmic sources. 👉 https:// theconversation.com/physics-no bel-highlights-antarcticas-role-in-exploring-the-cosmos-293906 # antarctica # icecube # astronomy # science # cosmos # meteorites # telescope # research # education # earth
